content:
arjun: Quick heads-up — planning an engine swap tomorrow 01:00 UTC. This is kernel v2.14 + quant profile 's64-prod'. Window is 20m. Need confirmation: who can own smoke, who owns rollback, who watches telemetry? Fallback image: redwood/runtime:v2.13-rollback. Policy: auto-fallback if 5xx rate > 1.5% for 5m.

maya: I can take smoke and kv-warm. Will run the post-deploy probes and run the perf script. @tony can you own rollback? :+1:

tony: Yep, I got rollback. I'll pre-push the rollback tag and keep `kubectl` command ready. Will be on call from 00:50 — ping me if anything weird.

arjun: thx. Smoke checklist (short): 
- KV warm (scripts/kv_warm.py)
- Run runtime_smoke.sh (health + latency)
- Run 10 sample inference requests with long-context
- Check tokenization/embeddings sanity

maya: smoke commands I run (for clarity):
```bash
./scripts/runtime_smoke.sh --env prod --host https://runtime.prod.redwood/api/health
curl -sS -X POST https://runtime.prod.redwood/api/generate -d '{"prompt":"tokenization-check","max_tokens":16}' -H "Content-Type: application/json"
# small load: heyload --concurrency 5 --samples 10 https://runtime.prod.redwood/api/generate
```

sre-ops: I'll mute the noisy latency alerts around the window (15m before -> 30m after). I'll also create a temporary dashboard filter for kernel v2.14. If auto-fallback triggers, I'll post the incident-note in #incidents.

arjun: automation notes: rollout will be via canary-style slice swap: 5% -> 25% -> 100% with 2m observation between steps. If error-rate or p50 latency regresses beyond thresholds we stop and fallback. CI gate: must have green e2e and perf smoke in main branch.

ci-bot: CI green for runtime/main at 3369999900. No blocking PRs.

tony: rollback command ready: 
```bash
kubectl -n prod set image deploy/runtime runtime=redwood/runtime:v2.13-rollback --record
# verify pods restart: kubectl get pods -l app=runtime -n prod
```

maya: I'll run the smoke script immediately after the last slice flips to 100% and paste results here. If I see >2% token errors or >200ms p50 bump, I'll request immediate rollback.

arjun: ownership summary: arjun (release lead, coordinates), maya (smoke + kv-warm), tony (rollback + cluster ops), sre-ops (alerts/dashboards), ci-bot/deploy-bot (automation). Please reply with :thumbsup: if available.

maya: :thumbsup: available.

ton y: :thumbsup: (typo in handle, meant tony) available.

sre-ops: :thumbsup: I'll be watching.

deploy-bot: Slot reserved for 2026-03-18T01:00:00Z (reservation id 36271). Reminder 10m before.

arjun: perfect. I'll push the rollout plan to the runbook and add a short preflight checklist to the PR. If anyone needs to swap ownership last-minute, mention here.

maya: one more ask — can we disable non-critical logging to reduce noise during swap? small change in config: `LOG_LEVEL=info` -> keep debug off.

arjun: done, will include in preflight. Thanks all — see you in the window.
